meta.score_type: Fixed-anchor climate/resource screening score (heuristic), NOT construction viability
meta.calibration_status: Weights AND fixed anchor limits are heuristic; no CAPEX/PUE/grid data calibration
meta.normalization_note: Fixed anchors do not change when candidates are added, but the active indicator set can.
assumptions: Monthly temperature means only, not free-cooling hours or electrical kWh
HAC uncertainty is for historical trend slope only
Future values are an illustrative linear scenario, NOT climate-model projections
Unreported metrics are excluded cohort-wide for fair comparison
Indicator availability and source measurement changes can change the index; candidate count alone does not change fixed-anchor scores

sources.solar: NASA POWER Monthly API (CERES ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, 2005-01..2024-12, converted from kWh/m2/day to monthly/annual kWh/m2 sums)
sources.wind: DTU Global Wind Atlas v3.3 (100m height above ground, 250m grid, mean power density W/m2, mean speed m/s & seasonal profile, https://globalwindatlas.info)
sources.terrain: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (90m grid via Open-Meteo Elevation API, https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/elevation-api)
sources.water: Copernicus GloFAS v4 Flood API & Copernicus DEM GLO-90 water-proximity stencil (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/flood-api)

trend.method: Seasonal fixed-effects OLS (calendar-month intercepts), HAC Newey-West SE
trend.warning: Historical slope confidence interval is not a 10-year prediction interval.

strengths.text: Lower estimated cooling-temperature pressure
Lower projected monthly average of daily highs
Stronger wind resource
Strong surface water access & discharge capacity

insight.methodology: Fixed illustrative reference anchors; resource screening only, not an engineering feasibility assessment
mandatory_checks: 24/7 firm supply, storage or grid connection
